module: Auxiliary controller for JATO thrusters (booster rockets, type "auxiliary", defaultOrder 1100). When electrics.values.jatoInput > 0, or when the throttle is fully pressed in gamepad/direct mode and moving forward, it consumes fuel, emits particles at the thruster nodes and plays a loop sound. Writes electrics.values.jato (0..1) and jatofuel (remaining fuel, ratio 0..1). A "JATO" button is added to the powertrain simplified control panel.
notes: jbeam keys (default): fuel (20, units of thrust time at full consumption), thrusterNodes_nodes (flat list of node pairs: emission node, direction node; the number of elements must be even otherwise an error is logged), thrusterLoopName ("event:>Vehicle>Thrusters").

The thrust itself (force) is not applied by this file: it only produces smoke, sound and electrics values (jato, jatofuel); the force must come from other jbeam elements that read electrics.values.jato.

Hidden function: the Konami code "uuddlrlrba" entered, registered by extensions.inputAnalyzer.registerInputString, toggles fuelCoef between 1 and 0 (infinite fuel when 0) and displays "When in doubt, JATO".
The interface button sets electrics.values.jatoInput to 1 - jatoInput. The field M.fuelCoef (1 by default) multiplies the consumption.

init.desc: Reads fuel and the thruster nodes, initializes electrics.values.jatoInput/jato and registers the secret code.

reset.desc: Resets the fuel to the initial level, stops the sounds and sets jatoInput/jato back to 0.

updateGFX.desc: Consumes fuel, emits particles and sounds, writes electrics.values.jato and jatofuel.

inputStringCallback.desc: Called by inputAnalyzer when the secret code is entered: toggles fuelCoef between 1 and 0.

updateSimpleControlButtons.desc: (Re)creates the "JATO" button of the simplified panel with the remaining fuel ratio.

getState.desc: Returns fuel and fuelCoef for saving.
